scripts.test: npm run test:sandbox && npm run test:github && npm run test:websearch && npm run test:memory && npm run test:doctor
scripts.doctor:check: bun -e "const m = await import('./extensions/00-doctor.ts'); const c = await m.runChecks({skipNetwork:true}); const e = c.filter(x=>x.status==='error'); if(e.length){ console.error(m.buildReportText(c, m.readOsRelease(), m.detectPackageManager())); process.exit(1); } console.log('doctor: ambiente OK');"
